rationale: This is a leg-swap recombination of two archive signals — the cash-to-operating-claims coverage ratio from "Cash-Covered Operating Profit" and the one-year core-margin delta from "Collection-Confirmed Margin Expansion" — and the archive already shows that replacing the persistent-profitability level with a noisy margin change weakens both the FMB and alpha evidence, so it is a cosmetic rather than substantive refinement.

The construction is internally coherent (high score = prior noncash-current-asset buildup plus subsequent profit deterioration, expected negative) and the asymmetric-failure framing is a defensible non-mirror-image follow-up to the weak "Accrual-Investment Payoff," though it sits close to the classic working-capital accrual anomaly and the MIN of two moderately correlated legs may just re-express lagged accruals.

This is the fourth denominator variant of the same "MIN(persistent profitability, bounded cash-coverage ratio)" template already tested with che/(che+lct−dlc), oancf/(|oancf|+|dlc|), and oancf/(|oancf|+ΔNCA), and because oancf and oibdp are strongly correlated the second leg largely collapses into inverse operating-liability intensity, making it an incremental reshuffle rather than a new mechanism.

It is a direct level-to-trend substitution on "Depreciation-Stress-Tested Profit" with the identical second leg (TS_RANK(dpc/at,5)), i.e., precisely the kind of one-operator cosmetic variant the objective warns against.

Beyond being the constructed mirror of the already-tested "Accrual-Capital Efficiency Breakout," the INDICATOR gate zeroes out the majority of the cross-section and leaves a signal with a large point mass at zero — the exact design that produced near-null FMB t-stats for every conditional proposal in this archive.

The re-specification (asset-scaled change in |aoloch| rather than a ratio to near-zero operating cash flow) is a genuine diagnostic fix with a consistent expected sign, though the MUL of a [0,1] rank with a signed z-score means low-profitability firms are compressed toward zero and the raw |aoloch| change is likely very noisy.
